resources.name: triage policy
resources.text:
# Triage policy

1. Read a ticket before changing it.
2. A ticket whose note records a reproduction moves to in_progress; one without a reproduction stays open.
3. A ticket that waits on another team is set blocked, and its note names the blocker.
4. Only a verified fix closes a ticket.

prompts.name: triage
prompts.description: Triage one ticket against the policy resource.
prompts.text: Triage ticket {{ticket_id}}: read it with get_ticket, apply tickets://policy, set its status with set_status, and read the status back with get_status before reporting.
